SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-29-2022 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF WHEELS FINANCIAL GROUP LLC DBA LOANMART IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM, REPRESENTED BY ULISES BORRAYO. DEFENDANT KEVIN THADDEUS BROWN IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF WAS INSTRUCTED BY THE CLERK TO SUBMIT SC-109 BY EMAIL TO DEPARTMENT506@SFTC.ORG. SC-109 HAS NOT BEEN RECEIVED. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU / W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
